package.description: Lightweight sticky notes for Windows 11 and 10 that dock to your screen edge.

en-US.description: Lightweight sticky notes for Windows 11 and 10 that dock to your screen edge.
en-US.longDescription: Stickies is a lightweight sticky notes app for Windows 11 and 10. Notes dock to the edge of your screen and fan out when you move the mouse there. Under 20 MB of RAM, notes encrypted on your PC with Windows DPAPI, optional PIN lock, slash commands, no account and no telemetry. $4.99 one-time with a 7-day free trial.
en-US.name: Stickies
